usage.neon: Use at 40–64 px on the established dark WSPRadar surface.
usage.monochrome: Inline the SVG and set the CSS color property. In an external img element, currentColor does not inherit the parent page color.
usage.decorative: When adjacent text already names the function, use an empty img alt or remove role/aria-labelledby and set aria-hidden="true" for inline SVG.
usage.accessible: If the icon carries meaning alone, retain its SVG title when inline, or supply the manifest alt text to the img element.
usage.color_semantics: Cyan and green extend the brand icon family. They do not define the Target/Reference or chart evidence legend.

icons.title: Signal quality
icons.alt: Two matched signal traces with a vertical arrow indicating their SNR difference.
icons.intended_placement: Signal Quality / ΔSNR feature, paired-signal explanation, first demo step.
icons.semantic_note: A measured difference between jointly decoded signals. The two colors do not assign a fixed winner.

icons.title: Decoding advantage
icons.alt: Paired comparison bars on both sides of a shared axis, with the longer side varying between rows.
icons.intended_placement: ΔDecode map or Decoding Advantage feature.
icons.semantic_note: Decode outcomes can favor either setup; the icon makes no universal-winner claim.

icons.title: Decoding reach
icons.alt: A weakening signal waveform above two station symbols, linking signal quality with station observations.
icons.intended_placement: From Signal Quality to Decoding Reach introduction or Weak Signals feature.
icons.semantic_note: Connects weaker signals to decoded observations and stations. It does not depict distance or promise greater geographical range.

icons.title: Joint and one-sided
icons.alt: Three paired rows showing both reports present, the left report only, and the right report only.
icons.intended_placement: Evidence explanation and symmetric Joint / Target-only / Reference-only outcomes.
icons.semantic_note: Filled markers mean an observed report. Both one-sided outcomes use the same visual treatment; colors are not assigned to Target and Reference.

icons.title: Operating window
icons.alt: Two station timelines aligned within one operating window under a shared clock.
icons.intended_placement: Before You Benchmark or operating-condition note near the setup call to action.
icons.semantic_note: Use a comparison window in which both setups are known to be operating. A clock and aligned intervals express that prerequisite, without implying inferred uptime.

icons.title: Station-balanced
icons.alt: Three station summaries of equal size feed one aggregate summary.
icons.intended_placement: Per-station summary / Aggregated Result explanation, only where equal station weighting applies.
icons.semantic_note: Each station contributes equally to the applicable aggregate. The symbol does not specify a median or claim that every WSPRadar metric uses this weighting.
